claim.summary: Exactly one guarded state or same-Bundle navigation action executes from exact current snapshots, through one detached token session, with post-callback TOCTOU checks and terminal navigation lifetime.

semantics.actionCardinality: exactly one state.set, state.toggle, or navigate action
semantics.guardOrdering: guard preparation and evaluation before discriminator and payload observation
semantics.falseGuard: zero payload reads, payload-token calls, diagnostic callback reports, state writes, or navigation calls; guard-token drift cannot be returned as skipped
semantics.tokenSession: one action-local detached cache shared by guard and payload; callbacks receiver-free
semantics.tokenAggregateOverflow: guard-rejected or payload-rejected invalid runtime-safety outcome depending phase; never reclassified as ADAPTER_FAILURE
semantics.individualProviderUnsafe: frozen M04-T03 ADAPTER_FAILURE classification for malformed or individually over-budget provider results
semantics.snapshotAuthority: exact current T06 state snapshot identity plus equal factory-authenticated resolution state
semantics.callbackToctou: exact state rechecked after token and diagnostic callbacks and immediately before effect
semantics.stateSet: complete-schema T06 write with rejected candidates not consuming request identity
semantics.stateToggle: only an exact JSON boolean may be inverted
semantics.navigationTarget: existing surface in the active same-Bundle inventory before params
semantics.navigationParams: canonical key order, one synthetic-array materialization, detached JSON reconstruction
semantics.navigationAdapterFailure: redacted ADAPTER_FAILURE for throw, Promise, or malformed result
semantics.navigationSuccess: terminal for old executor and T06 state, including same-surface navigation
semantics.explicitDisposal: terminal and idempotent for executor and owned T06 state
semantics.retainedSnapshotProvenance: state authority exact here; complete same-turn cross-manager provenance remains M04-T16
